_comment: Custom model providers for pi, stowed to ~/.pi/agent/models.json.
pi merges these with the providers it discovers itself (anthropic,
openai-codex, openai, radius -- cached in models-store.json, which is pi's
and not ours to edit). Only providers pi cannot find on its own belong here.
Enabling is separate: a provider defined here still has to be listed in
apiKey takes $VAR / ${VAR} and interpolates from the environment, so the key
itself never lands in this repo -- it is public. MODEL_API_KEY is exported
Costs are $/Mtok from dev.meta.ai/docs/pricing-rate-limits, standard tier.
Meta publishes one cached-input rate and no separate cache-write rate, so
cacheWrite is set to the plain input rate. There is no long-context premium.
NOT the contributor tier. muse-spark-*-contributor is ~12x cheaper
($0.10/$0.20/$0.002) but requires consenting to Meta training on prompts and
completions, with undisclosed retention and no documented revocation. Client
code goes through these harnesses; that settles it.
maxTokens is a conservative floor -- Meta documents the 1M context window but
not a max output. Raise it if a long generation gets truncated.
